label: About
title: About Phosphor Contractor Hinge Field
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1207 recent saved-signal files and 319 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around Anchor image material 2 and @100o111: I would like to revisit my work The website is a garden made out of 999 found images..., plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Phosphor Contractor Hinge Field: Phosphor-contractor hinge field, a game-space surface in browserless media-shrine grammar: black CRT glass holds a front-facing armored apparatus at left, a dominant cyan square plate split by a low helmet-module, and a right procession of small technical cells. A chrome barrel and red A-frame rods thrust diagonally... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against left full-body armored silhouette edge, central helmet faceplate and visor glass, and cyan framed square plate above helmet.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
